title: Salt Glacier Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: A classic menthol with a pronounced, refreshing aftertaste, Salt’s Glacier ejuice delivers that premium menthol refreshment with a crisp, clean and subtle aftertaste that lingers long on the palate. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
